paper_title: Continual Generalized Category Discovery: Learning and Forgetting from a Bayesian Perspective
official_binding: Accepted PMLR paper abstract explicitly links daihao42/VB-CGCD; exact experiment/checkpoint release binding not verified.
license: No LICENSE/COPYING file in complete untruncated pinned tree. Public access is not permission to copy/import; no upstream source copied or executed.
paper_read_scope: Accepted paper introduction/related work, method3.1-3.3/Algorithm1, experiments4.1-4.2/ablations/fewer-labeled setting, conclusion/discussion/impact statement; appendixC.3 hardware/hyperparameters andD.1-D.2 extensions. Not all mathematical appendix proofs, supplemental tables or figures visually.
original_task: Session-batched exemplar-free mixed old/new image continual GCD, frozen offline-finetuned backbone, Gaussian class-conditional distribution classifier; not current-frame causal persistent video category discovery.
model_inputs: Extracted static-image features, offline Known labels, prescribed base/increment/total class count. Critical active incremental path also reads training GT to align cluster IDs before distribution training; not a label-free path.
model_outputs: Fixed num_classes Gaussian mean/full-covariance rows in num_dim PCA space; argmax multivariate-normal log probability over every allocated row, without masking not-yet-introduced rows.
losses: Feature extractor uses Known image cross-entropy through BOFT DINO plus linear classifier. Classifier uses NumPyro SVI/Trace_ELBO wrapper but active model has deterministic numpyro.param means/covariances, empty guide and only observed MultivariateNormal sample; no inspected latent prior/variational KL term. Treat as inspected likelihood optimization, not verified Bayesian posterior inference.
training_protocol: CIFAR active feature path filters classes<50 then BOFT output.dense/mlp.fc1/mlp.fc2,10epochs/AdamW0.001/batch128/center224. Main defaults1000 distribution steps/batch128/lr4e-6 with100step warmup to10x then exponential0.85/500. PCA384 fitted on first/base training data only and frozen thereafter. Each later session full-data GMM fit then GT-Hungarian aligned labels, initial fit, predicted-novel filtering and second fit.
online_or_offline: Offline stage fine-tuning then whole-session clustering/repeated optimization before evaluation. Session-constrained continual benchmark is not single-arrival online inference.
causal_or_noncausal: Whole-session GMM and two repeated fitting passes depend on later examples in that session; incremental GT alignment directly influences training state. Pure frozen _predict only features+params but that does not cleanse state lineage. No GT/future/ID mutation certificate.
state_memory: Deep-copied fixed-size class means/covariances carry between sessions; no dynamic unknown births, WAIT, quarantine, versioned semantic events or member-level rollback. SVI-state rollback on determinant/NaN stop is optimizer rollback, not category-history correction.
evaluation: Direct argmax accuracy on old/new/all/base test sets; training GT Hungarian alignment fixes numerical row labels upstream. Test labels logged every100steps and at stop, but inspected stop decisions are determinant/NaN based, not test-ACC best selection. Do not equate this with lawful label-free discovery or fixed-Known online CT.
static_source_paper_differences_not_exec: main incremental clustering.predict(train_data._x, train_data._y, with_known=True) invokes GT novel_mask/confusion_matrix/Hungarian; matched row labels feed s_classifier.run. This is actual supervised lineage in released path, not merely external evaluation.

Paper Eq7 describes variational latent means/covariance, prior and KL; model() uses only numpyro.param and observed likelihood with guide=lambda:None. Imported AutoMultivariateNormal is unused. No matrix-normal/inverse-Wishart prior or covariance EMA is implemented in this inspected active path.

Paper Eq3 includes contrastive loss; sl_finetuned_model actual finetune uses only cross_entropy. Paper appendixC.3 k-means/fixed1e-5 differs from released sklearn GaussianMixture and warmup/exponential4e-6 scheduler.

Paper relabeling Algorithm1 second SVI uses reassigned labels; train() only filters by predicted>=label_offset and retains original incoming GT-aligned labels for second fitting, not pred_labels as second targets.

num_classes preallocates future rows; _predict loops every row, including unintroduced zero-mean/identity rows. No active unknown-K/silhouette extension found in inspected tree, despite appendixD.1 result.

Covariance numpyro.param has no inspected SPD constraint/factor parameterization; determinants in384D may be numerically fragile. No numerical failure was measured; no silent repair or installed NumPyro execution.

Actual early stopping uses mean determinants, class-count-dependent scale, old determinant >1/<1 branches, step>num_steps/3 and rollback to prior SVI state. Paper Eq11 logarithmic epsilon0.01 rule is not the active comparison.
scaling_factor and early_stop_ratio are stored but not used in active determinant decisions; do not claim these CLI knobs reproduce paper hyperparameter ablations.

Main rng_key from args.seed unused; SVI.init hardcodesPRNGKey0 each pass. Source uses typing.override unavailable in basePython3.10; JAX/NumPyro/Optax/continuum/PEFT compatibility not installed or certified.
StrictPerClassIncrementalLoader computes remainder arrays but returns full x,y pools; reuse across stages can occur by source structure. Not a measured data duplication count or dataset claim.
Only CIFAR feature/loader path audited; other datasets, checkpoints, external transformers/PEFT/JAX dependency internals and dataset files are unopened.
paper_limitations_summary: Author discussion flags clustering-initialization dependence and small-sample covariance estimation; D.1 count estimation incurs clustering errors. Additional causal/GT/privacy/lifecycle transfer gaps inferred from active source, not author-claimed outcomes.
TrackOCD_root_connection: Covariance/likelihood geometry is a testable control for Raw versus adapted discrimination loss and mixed-state reuse, but our historical covariance cause is not established and this GT-aligned session path is not a lawful recovery mechanism.
what_to_borrow: Independently implemented bounded Train-only covariance/dispersion diagnostics and frozen-feature controls after lawful fold selection, with full-denominator evaluation and small-sample regularization as hypotheses.
what_not_to_borrow: Incremental GT alignment/novel-count oracle/fullsession fitting, inferred Bayesian regularization absent from active code, unsupervised legality by filename, optimizer rollback as reversible semantic memory.
